rule: Kit for a building, first match wins: (1) 'overrides' by building id; (2) 'by_osm_building' by the OSM building=* value; (3) 'by_wall_material' by the Stage 1 wall material (v2 model.json materials, first wall id); (4) 'default'. The OSM snapshot has no building:material, start_date or building:architecture tags on any campus building (checked 2026-11-20), so age cannot be used yet; add an override when a building's style is known from photos.
